select prd.finprod_id id, IFNULL(prd.finprod_abbr,prd.finprod_name) text from fin_product prd where prd.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND prd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND (prd.finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR prd.finprod_abbr like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR prd.finprod_name like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%'))
order by prd.finprod_id
